newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle light at $70 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle light at $70 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 2,400 slaughter steers and 2,000 heifers; 87,100 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 17,200 formulated cattle and 200 contracts to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 70.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 69.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1100 lbs 70.00, pen North Plains 70.50. Select, few Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 69.00.
Wk to Date - 87,100 Week Ago - 29,800 Year Ago - 58,800
